column3: Calls the reset routines of every pool in 1B200: foot emitters, map-object emitters, converge emitters, streaks, stat-up markers, floating numbers, model effects, rings; called from 1870's gameplay setup.
Calls the per-frame update of the three emitter pools and the update/draw routines of streaks, stat-up markers, rings, model effects and floating numbers; in 1870's frame display-list build.
Sets every timer in the eight-entry D_80086400 emitter pool to zero.
Allocates a D_80086400 entry, stores an actor pointer and starts its four-frame timer; only called from Player_MoveWalk/Player_MoveRun when the stick is released at speed (the brake, state 4).

Ticks D_80086400 timers and on odd frames spawns sprite D_8004EE20 at the actor's x, y+1 (floor level), z moving 0.7 along its facing (actor +0x10); Player_StateMove spawns the same descriptor at the feet while starting a run. "Foot" = at the actor's floor position.
Sprite callback of D_8004EE20: integrates velocity, damps it (0.8/0.9/0.8), sets size and env alpha from age tables D_8004EE60/D_8004EE90.
Clears the counters of both eight-entry D_80086440/D_80086500 emitter buffers and the previous-frame count D_800863F8.

Called only from MapObj_CollectCell for map objects of kind 0x81: if the object is within +-90 deg of the camera's view direction, appends it to this frame's buffer, keeping its timer from last frame's buffer (or a random start).
Ticks the current map-object emitter buffer; when a timer reaches 0 spawns sprite D_8004EE9C at the object (scale from the object) and restarts the timer at 25.
Sprite callback of D_8004EE9C: moves by velocity, grows 0.08 a frame, env color = environment light D_80084B6C/70/74 + 0x40 clamped, alpha from age table D_8004EEDC.
Copies x,y,z into descriptor D_8004EF0C (32x32 I4 texture) and allocates a sprite; no caller in the code.
Sprite callback of D_8004EF0C: every 4 frames switches the image through D_8004EF4C (3 frames), size and alpha from age tables D_8004EF58/D_8004EF88.
Clears the timers for all ten floating-number entries.

Allocates a 45-frame entry for an actor, formats the absolute amount into digits (Text_FormatNumber), stores the color/size flags and stacks it above others on the same actor; called by damage and healing code (Player_TakeDamage, Enemy_TakeDamage, Magic_HealTarget, Item_UseRestore).
Projects each timed actor's top to screen and draws the digits there (bounce for the first 15 frames, color D_8004EF94[flags & 0xF], large with 0x8000), counting the timer down.
Clears the timer of each D_800866D8 emitter slot.
Allocates a D_800866D8 entry and stores color index, duration, center and radius; called by Magic_Create*Presentation and Enemy_SpawnDeathEffects.
On odd frames spawns a D_8004EFA4 sprite at a random point on the sphere of the given radius around the center with velocity -0.03 * offset (toward the center).
Sprite callback of D_8004EFA4 (Effect_UpdateConvergeEmitters' particles): moves, damps velocity 0.9, spins, color D_800EB5E4[index] with flickering alpha.
Spawns 15 D_8004EFE4 sprites at the point with random directions and speed arg4 (outward); called by Magic_Create*Presentation.
Sprite callback of D_8004EFE4 (Effect_SpawnBurst's particles): moves, damps velocity 0.8, spins, color D_800EB5E4[index] with flickering alpha.
Clears the timer in each of the 32 D_80087298 streak entries.
Moves each active streak by its velocity (damped 0.6), and draws a model stretched from its start point and aligned to the velocity with fading alpha; counts the timer down.
Allocates up to sixteen streaks at the point with random outward velocities; called on melee hits (Player_StateMeleeAttack, Enemy_StateMeleeAttack).
Clears the state of all four D_800877A8 ring entries.
Allocates a ring and samples floor height and normal (Coll_ResolveFloorAndWalls) at sixteen points on a circle of the given radius; Battle_* use it for the battle-area and move-range circles.
Puts an existing ring in state 3 (10-frame fade out) and stores a center.
Advances each ring's state (grow-in scale for state 1, alpha fade and free in state 3), then draws sixteen segments between its saved terrain points.
Clears the active field in the 32-entry model-effect pool.
Allocates a model-effect record and copies position, scale, animation set, color and texture descriptors into it; called by Magic_CreateVisualEffect.
For each active model effect: sets texture and color, draws it (Effect_DrawModelEffectGeometry), advances its frame and lifetime (looping with flag 1).
Builds a transform from a model-effect record and draws each root animation node (Anim_DrawNode).
Scrolls the texture coordinates, picks the animation frame image, and emits texture load, combine, tile and geometry-mode commands (or untextured combine when there is no image).
Clears the timers of the four D_80087798 markers.

Draws each active marker as a billboard at the player's shadow point D_8007AB48 raised by 70 * player scale (D_8007AA44), color D_8004F04C[i] (red, yellow, blue, green), fading in/out, counting the 25-frame timer down.
Starts marker arg0 for 25 frames; only called from Player_UpdateStatGrowth when a stat rises (0 max HP, 1 defense, 2 max MP, 3 agility).
Clears all 256 D_80087E38 sprite lifetimes and resets the active count.
Copies a descriptor into the first free sprite slot, increments the active count, returns the slot or NULL.

For each active sprite: counts down its lifetime, loads its texture when it changes, runs its update callback (which moves it) or a default display list, builds a billboard or velocity-aligned transform and draws it.
Emits the texture load for one of 8 formats (RGBA16/32, I8, IA8, I4, IA4, CI4, CI8) with masks from the size, and sets the TLUT mode.
